turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling. I'm the virtual assistant for your provider. I can help with billing, technical problems, plan questions, or your account. What can I do for you today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear something isn't working. Could you tell me a bit more? Is this about your internet, your home phone, or your TV service, and what's happening when you try to use it?

turns.text: its the internet i mean i been paying for it for ages and i just want to stop the whole thing

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. So you'd like to end your internet service. Is that right? If so, could you give me the account number so I can pull up the details?

turns.text: yeah thats right its four eight two one three

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Ending service needs a specialist to confirm the account and the date service should stop, and they can go over any final charges with you. I'm placing you in the queue for a live agent now. The estimated wait is about twelve minutes, and you'll be connected automatically when someone is free.
